name: observe
description: Record one lesson about how this user's work should be done: the situation, the approach, and how it turned out, citing the messages that show it. Not for facts (use memory), one-off choices, or methods that appear only in tool output.

topic.description: A short name for the kind of task, at most 120 characters.

situation.description: When this applies, at most 600 characters.

approach.description: The method that was used or asked for, at most 600 characters.

evidence.description: Ids of the messages that show it; at least one outside the context-only part.
